name: @telefunc/drizzle-experimental
description: Experimental reactive Drizzle queries for Telefunc — server-owned live-query invalidation derived from the SQL your telefunctions run.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist/ && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json

// telefunc peer floor: Requires the serializer's LIVE-config union read for response types registered during telefunc-file evaluation (telefunc PR: serializeTelefunctionResult). On 0.2.0-0.2.22 the serializer read the request-start config snapshot, so the replacer this package registers from a module-level reactiveDrizzle() was invisible to the very request that loaded it and a Live serialized as a plain object with NO error. 0.2.23 is the next unreleased patch at time of writing (main was 0.2.22); if the fix ships under a different number, raise this floor to match at release time. Enforced by src/compat.spec.ts, which fails if the installed telefunc lacks the fix.
